articles.title: TotalEnergies Now Sees Oil Demand Peaking Between 2035 and 2040
articles.description: A year after forecasting that oil demand would keep rising until 2040, TotalEnergies has moved its peak forward to between 2035 and 2040, and says the Iran war could accelerate the energy transition.
